blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Education (DepEd) and the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) have forged a partnership to strengthen school safety by deploying barangay tanods within school premises and integrating the agency into the country’s unified 911 emergency system amid incidents of school shootings and other threats. The agreement is covered by a joint memorandum circular (JMC) signed by the two agencies on Oct. 14, when Education Secretary Sonny Angara and Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla led a joint school safety audit and drill at Bangkal High School in Makati City.
